_comment: Wave 4: phBound's nine defaults and cityLevel's six constant answers.
phBound's SetFriction/SetElasticity are each a PAIR overloaded on parameters - f32 Name()
reads, void Name(f32) writes - and the reader returns 0.5 for both. An earlier pass misread
these as dropped x87 returns; the kit has the value, and the mistake was in extracting one
body for every overload of a name rather than matching the signature.
Excluded: cityLevel::GetWaterLevel returns the unsymbolised global at 0x0062998C.
